Name: Ownership Marker
Author: VotriValley
Description:
[heading][b]Ownership Marker[/b][/heading]
[b]About this mod[/b]
Ownership Marker adds simple visual markers above Pokémon, companions, summons, pets, and farm animals, making it easier to see who they belong to at a glance.
💎 Marker Colors
[list]
[*]💚 [b]Green[/b] — Yours [/*]
[*]💙 [b]Blue[/b] — Another player's [/*]
[*]💛 [b]Yellow[/b] — NPC / partner companion [/*]
[/list]Wild, quest, and battle-only creatures are left unmarked.
[line]
[b]🐾 Supported[/b]
[list]
[*]Pelipper Town Pokémon[/*]
[*]Vanilla pets — dogs, cats & turtles[/*]
[*]Farm animals[/*]
[*]Multiplayer ownership[/*]
[*]Designed to work with Pokémon, companion, and summon-style mods through integration support[/*]
[/list][line]
[b]📦 Requirements[/b]
[b]Required:[/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400][b]SMAPI[/b][/url] [/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915][b]Content Patcher[/b][/url] [/*]
[/list][b]Optional:[/b]

[list]
[*][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/51072]PokeFarmRetextures[/url][/b][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/50344][b]Pelipper Town[/b][/url][/*]
[/list][line]
[b]🔧 Compatibility[/b]
Works as a standalone mod and is designed to coexist with PokéFarm Retextures without duplicate ownership markers.
Simple, lightweight, and purely visual.
Know what is yours, what belongs to someone else, and what is following an NPC. 💚💙💛
[line]
